_howToPublish: Add an object to items for each approved note. quote, name (first name only), and detail are required. date is optional (YYYY-MM).

items.quote: Mrs. Thurmond was my daughter’s 4th grade teacher. My daughter is dyslexic and reading had been a real struggle until that year. That was when she actually learned to read. I believe it happened because of the energy Mrs. Thurmond poured into her and the kindness she just naturally has. She is a genuinely good person. My daughter still brings up her sweet teacher from time to time. I would recommend her to anyone.
items.name: Jessica
